destinations.name: Gulmarg
destinations.tagline: Asia's Premier Ski Paradise & Highest Cable Car
destinations.description: Nestled at 8,694 ft in the Pir Panjal range, Gulmarg is world-renowned for powdery alpine ski slopes and the iconic Gulmarg Gondola that ascends to 13,780 ft at Apharwat Peak.
destinations.bestTime: Dec - Mar (Snow/Ski) | May - Sep (Lush Golf & Meadows)
destinations.snowStatus: Heavy powder snow active at Phase 1 & 2
thingsToDo: Ride the world's second-highest operating cable car
Take certified ski lessons with licensed instructors
Warm up with hot Kahwa at Kongdoori bowl
destinations.howToReach: Drive via Srinagar-Baramulla Highway to Tangmarg; switch to 4x4 snow chain vehicles for the final 12 km alpine climb during winter.
destinations.hiddenGemTip: Visit Drung Frozen Waterfall in early morning before tour crowds arrive.

destinations.name: Pahalgam
destinations.tagline: Lidder River Symphony & Pine-Clad Romantic Glades
destinations.description: Situated at the confluence of streams flowing from Sheshnag Lake and Lidder River, Pahalgam offers sweeping pine meadows, rushing trout streams, and tranquil valley trails.
destinations.bestTime: April - November (Greenery & Rafting) | Dec - Feb (Winter Snow)
destinations.snowStatus: Snow blanket in upper Aru & Chandanwari
thingsToDo: Picnic on the banks of Lidder River
Hike through Aru's traditional wooden log villages
Taste fresh river trout at riverside wood bistros
destinations.howToReach: Comfortable drive through saffron town Pampore and Awantipora ruins along NH 44.
destinations.hiddenGemTip: Aru Valley is far more peaceful in the afternoon after day-trippers return to Pahalgam center.

destinations.name: Srinagar
destinations.tagline: Carved Walnut Houseboats, Floating Markets & Mughal Gardens
destinations.description: The summer capital and heartbeat of Kashmir, famous for Dal and Nigeen Lakes, floating shikaras, ancient wooden shrines, and terraces of Nishat & Shalimar Mughal gardens.
destinations.bestTime: All Year Round (Tulip Festival in April; Chinar Gold in Autumn)
destinations.snowStatus: Chilly winter air; snow on surrounding mountain rims
thingsToDo: Stay in an authentic carved cedar houseboat on Nigeen Lake
Drink Kehwa on a shikara near Char Chinar
Explore Downtown copper bazaar
destinations.howToReach: Srinagar Airport (SXR) has daily direct flights from Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chandigarh, and Jammu.
destinations.hiddenGemTip: Nigeen Lake has 80% fewer noisy motorboats than Boulevard Dal Lake, ideal for tranquility.

destinations.name: Sonamarg
destinations.tagline: Glacier Gateways to Ladakh & Sparkling Sindh Waters
destinations.description: Surrounded by soaring snow-bound peaks like Kolahoi, Sonamarg is the majestic gateway where Sindh river carves through mountain cliffs and ancient glaciers.
destinations.bestTime: April to October | Winter access now open via Z-Morh Tunnel
destinations.snowStatus: Year-round snow at Thajiwas Glacier and Nilagrad
nearbyAttractions: Krishnasar & Vishansar Alpine Lakes Trek base
thingsToDo: Hike up to Thajiwas glacier snout
Taste authentic highway Kangri tea
Photograph wild alpine meadows
destinations.howToReach: NH1 road towards Leh; recently fortified with the state-of-the-art Z-Morh tunnel ensuring winter connectivity.
destinations.hiddenGemTip: Drive 10 km past Sonamarg town towards Baltal for breathtaking untouched cliffside vistas.

destinations.name: Doodhpathri
destinations.tagline: Pristine Frothing Streams & Unspoiled Rolling Alpine Downs
destinations.description: Located right here in Budgam district, Doodhpathri is an unspoiled bowl of velvet green pastures where the Shaliganga river froths with milky white water over river stones.
destinations.bestTime: May to October (Lush Downs) | Dec to Feb (Snow Sanctuary)
destinations.snowStatus: Serene snow glades with no crowded commercial noise
thingsToDo: Dip your hands into icy mountain water
Enjoy fresh roasted corn and tea with local shepherds
Hike to Dikshal ridges
destinations.howToReach: Smooth drive through Budgam town, Khansahib pine belt, and winding alpine forests.
destinations.hiddenGemTip: Because Kashmiré Voyages office is located in Budgam, we offer private luxury day hampers and private guides here.

destinations.name: Gurez Valley
destinations.tagline: Crown of Habba Khatoon Peak & The Sacred Kishanganga River
destinations.description: Deep in the northern borderlands across the 11,672 ft Razdan Pass lies Gurez—a timeless valley of log homes, Dard-Shin tribal culture, and Habba Khatoon's poetic pyramid peak.
destinations.bestTime: June to October (Summer) | Dedicated snow permits in early winter
thingsToDo: Hear the folk ballad of poet queen Habba Khatoon
Cross the roaring Kishanganga river suspension footbridges
destinations.howToReach: Drive from Srinagar via Bandipora and climb up the zig-zagging Razdan Pass into Dawar.
destinations.hiddenGemTip: Kashmiré Voyages handles all northern district permit documentation in advance.

destinations.name: Yusmarg
destinations.tagline: Endless Green Undulations & The Roaring Doodh Ganga
destinations.description: A tranquil paradise flanked by Sunset Peak (Tatadoti) and Sang-e-Safed valley. Less commercialized than Gulmarg, offering miles of virgin pine forest walks.
destinations.bestTime: May to October (Lush Downs) | Jan - Feb (Snow Solitude)
destinations.snowStatus: Quiet snow glens with zero lift crowds
thingsToDo: Walk alongside Doodh Ganga's roaring gushing waters
Taste fresh Kashmiri walnut pastries en-route
destinations.howToReach: Accessible via Chadoora and Charar-e-Sharief highway through Apple orchards.
destinations.hiddenGemTip: Nilnag is a blue water lake hidden in pine trees reachable by a 4 km picturesque walk.

destinations.name: Sinthan Top
destinations.kashmiriName: سنتھن ٹاپ (The 12,500 ft High Mountain Pass)
destinations.tagline: 360-Degree Himalayan Snow Panoramas Linking Kashmir to Kishtwar
destinations.description: Perched at 12,500 ft on the Breng valley border, Sinthan Top offers snow availability even in late summer, with sweeping views of Pir Panjal and Chenab valleys.
destinations.recommendedStay: Stay at Kokernag / Daksum & day pass
destinations.snowStatus: Snow present until mid-July at top pass
thingsToDo: Stand with one foot in Kashmir valley and one in Jammu province
Pack hot thermos tea for the freezing pass winds
destinations.howToReach: Via Anantnag, Kokernag, and Daksum forest road.
destinations.hiddenGemTip: Pair with an overnight stay in the JKTDC wooden chalets of Daksum pine glade.

destinations.name: Aharbal Waterfall
destinations.tagline: Thundering Mountain Falls & The Pristine Kounsarnag Trail
destinations.description: Where the roaring Veshav river plunges 25 meters down sheer basalt canyon rock, surrounded by deep fir and pine woods in Kulgam district.
destinations.recommendedStay: Day excursion from Srinagar or 1 Night
destinations.snowStatus: Winter ice cascades and snow banks
activities: Trek towards Kounsarnag high glacial lake
thingsToDo: Feel the mist of the crashing falls on the secure iron viewing decks
Taste fresh crisp Honeycrisp apples right from trees in autumn
destinations.howToReach: Drive via Pulwama or Shopian apple capital.
destinations.hiddenGemTip: Stop in Shopian for the freshest autumn apples and walnuts directly from growers.

destinations.name: Dachigam National Park
destinations.tagline: Last Sanctuary of the Royal Hangul Stag & Himalayan Black Bear
destinations.description: Spanning 141 sq km right behind Srinagar's Zabarwan mountains, Dachigam protects the critically endangered Hangul (Kashmir Stag) in untouched oak and birch wilderness.
destinations.bestTime: October - March (Hangul in Lower Dachigam) | May - Aug (Flora & Upper Trails)
thingsToDo: Carry telephoto lenses for deer spotting
Experience the pure silence of the protected reserve
destinations.howToReach: Scenic drive alongside Dal Lake, Shalimar, and Harwan canal.
destinations.hiddenGemTip: Department permits must be applied 24 hours prior; our team manages everything.

timelineItems.title: Alpine Breakfast on Lakefront Deck

timelineItems.title: Scenic Departure for Gulmarg via Tangmarg
timelineItems.description: Chauffeured drive through weeping willow country and pine-scented foothills. Brief stop at Tangmarg for snow equipment check.

timelineItems.title: Mountain Pine Lunch & Hot Wazwan
timelineItems.description: Relaxing lunch featuring Rogan Josh and fresh garlic naan at Highland Park Resort with roaring pine wood fireplace.

timelineItems.title: Gulmarg Gondola Phase 2 to Apharwat Peak (13,780 ft)
timelineItems.description: Boarding the iconic cable car to reach high alpine snow bowl. Breathless views of K2, Nanga Parbat, and deep snow fields.

timelineItems.title: Return to Resort & Bonfire Evening
timelineItems.description: Cozying up by the hearth with spiced kahwa, sharing photographs from the peaks, and stargazing in crystal Himalayan mountain skies.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Srinagar Airport Arrival & Nigeen Houseboat Romance
dayWiseItinerary.description: VIP meet and greet at Srinagar Airport. Transfer to luxury houseboat. Relax with saffron Kahwa. In the evening, embark on a private sunset shikara ride across tranquil lotus canals.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg: Ascent to Apharwat Snows
dayWiseItinerary.description: Scenic drive via Tangmarg pine forests to Gulmarg. Check into pine resort. Board Gulmarg Gondola up to Kongdoori and Apharwat peak for snow play and scenic views.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam: Through the Saffron Valleys
dayWiseItinerary.description: Travel through the saffron fields of Pampore and historic Awantipora ruins. Arrive in Pahalgam by the singing Lidder river. Evening leisure at the riverside promenade.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Betaab Valley, Aru & Baisaran 'Mini Switzerland'
dayWiseItinerary.description: Excursion to Betaab Valley, named after the Bollywood romance. Continue into pristine Aru Valley village. Optional horse ride to Baisaran alpine green meadow.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Pahalgam to Srinagar: Mughal Heritage & Old Downtown
dayWiseItinerary.description: Return to Srinagar. Visit royal terraced gardens: Nishat Bagh and Shalimar Bagh. Sunset from Pari Mahal with sweeping views over Dal Lake.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Farewell to Paradise
dayWiseItinerary.description: Final morning breakfast overlooking the mountains. Transfer to Srinagar International Airport with commemorative Kashmiri saffron gift box.
